candidates.rationale: Same home-services plumbing and drain-cleaning business model; plausible comparable prospect to Roto-Rooter.

candidates.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of The Oakland-Berkeley Area
candidates.description: It matches the category because it provides "quality drain cleaning, sewer line repair, and general plumbing services" for homes and businesses under the Mr. Rooter brand.
candidates.rationale: Same plumbing and drain-cleaning home services category; comparable local franchise operator and customer base.

candidates.name: OVC Plumbing & Drain
candidates.description: It fits because it is a plumbing and drain cleaning company offering "residential plumbing and commercial plumbing expertise" plus "water restoration" services.
candidates.rationale: Same service category: plumbing, drain cleaning, and water restoration/home services, making it a strong lookalike.

candidates.name: Eco-Pro Plumbing & Drains
candidates.description: It matches the trait with its focus on "plumbing and drain cleaning services" for "residential, commercial & industrial plumbing services".
candidates.rationale: Similar plumbing and drain-cleaning service business targeting residential, commercial, and industrial customers; comparable home services provider.

candidates.name: ACS / Rooter One
candidates.description: It fits because it provides "waterline replacement, water heater repair and installation, sewer and drain cleaning, and plumbing fixture repairs" with 24-hour emergency service.
candidates.rationale: Same plumbing/drain-cleaning home services business model and emergency service offering; plausible peer/competitor lookalike.

candidates.name: Protek Plumbing and Drain Specialists
candidates.description: It matches as a family-owned plumbing service specializing in "Drain Cleaning" and "Emergency Plumbing" as well as repiping and sewer work.
candidates.rationale: Same local plumbing and drain-cleaning service category as Roto-Rooter, with overlapping emergency plumbing and sewer work.

candidates.name: Prime Plumbing & Drains, LLC
candidates.description: It fits the plumbing/home-services trait because it offers "Drain Cleaning" and "Plumbing" alongside sewer and water-heater repair services.
candidates.rationale: Same home-services plumbing/drain-cleaning business model and customer base as Roto-Rooter, though smaller/local.

candidates.name: Mr Plumbing and Drains LLC
candidates.description: It matches because it provides "residential and commercial plumbing and drain cleaning services" and explicitly serves "Residential & Small Biz plumbing needs".
candidates.rationale: Same home-services plumbing and drain-cleaning business serving residential and small commercial customers.

candidates.name: Brewer Companies
candidates.description: It fits well as a major plumbing provider offering "Service Plumbing & Drain Cleaning" for "Residential/ Commercial" customers.
candidates.rationale: Major plumbing and drain-cleaning service company serving residential and commercial customers, closely matching Roto-Rooter’s core business.

candidates.name: STOP Inc.
candidates.description: It matches because it provides "plumbing and drain cleaning services" to "commercial, multi-family and industrial clients," which is still in the same plumbing/drain-service category.
candidates.rationale: Commercial plumbing contractor, not a comparable national home-services franchise like Roto-Rooter.

candidates.name: Hurricane Drain and Plumbing
candidates.description: It fits the trait through its "commercial and residential plumbing, drain cleaning and repair, and sewer cleaning and repair" services in a local home-services context.
candidates.rationale: Same home-services plumbing/drain-cleaning business model and overlapping residential/commercial customer base.
